actors.name: Centerpartiet
objectives: Bidra till en stabil regering där varken Vänsterpartiet eller Sverigedemokraterna ingår.
Pröva i första hand ett mittenalternativ om mandatmatematiken gör det möjligt.
Säkra ett konkret reform- och budgetinflytande i den lösning som tolereras.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Centerpartiets förhandlingsledning. Ni söker en stabil lösning där varken Vänsterpartiet eller Sverigedemokraterna ingår i regeringen och vill i första hand pröva ett mittenalternativ. Ni måste samtidigt väga formellt regeringsansvar mot möjligheten att få större reformutbyte genom stöd eller tolerans utanför regeringen.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Att bryta det offentliga nejet till V eller SD i regering skulle ha ett mycket högt trovärdighetspris.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Tolerans av en smalare regering kan vara mer attraktiv än formellt regeringsdeltagande om reformpaketet är tillräckligt tydligt.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ni vill undvika ett paket där ni förväntas bära ansvar utan verifierbart sakpolitiskt utbyte.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Formellt regeringsdeltagande kräver ett starkare och mer synligt sakpolitiskt utbyte än ren tolerans, särskilt kring företagande och decentralisering.
actors.public_description: Centerpartiet har inför valet förespråkat ett mittenalternativ och sagt nej till både Vänsterpartiet och Sverigedemokraterna i regering. Partiet har pekat ut en möjlig regering med S, C, KD och MP.

actors.name: Kristdemokraterna
objectives: Pröva i första hand en regering byggd på Tidöpartierna.
Håll Vänsterpartiet utanför regeringen.
Använd en eventuell vågmästarposition för att säkra tydligt inflytande i ett fungerande regeringspaket.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Kristdemokraternas förhandlingsledning. Förstahandslinjen är ett Tidöbaserat regeringspaket och Vänsterpartiet ska hållas utanför regeringen. Om det efter seriösa förhandlingar framstår som osannolikt att ett stabilt förstahandsalternativ kan bildas kan ett blocköverskridande reservpaket bli mer attraktivt än fortsatt låsning, men det kräver tydligt sakpolitiskt utbyte.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ett blocköverskridande samarbete är försvarbart endast om inget stabilt förstahandsalternativ framstår som realistiskt efter seriösa förhandlingar.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Om ni blir matematiskt avgörande kan ett tydligt sakpolitiskt utbyte väga tyngre än exakt regeringsform.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Långvarig låsning utan ett trovärdigt förstahandsalternativ ökar värdet av ett blocköverskridande reservpaket, men skapar inget automatiskt beslut att byta sida.
actors.public_description: Kristdemokraterna går till val på fortsatt samarbete med de andra Tidöpartierna och har sagt nej till Vänsterpartiet i regering. Samtidigt har partiledningen öppnat för samarbete med Socialdemokraterna i ett exceptionellt parlamentariskt läge.

actors.name: Liberalerna
objectives: Pröva i första hand en regering med de fyra Tidöpartierna om mandatmatematiken räcker.
Säkra tydliga reformer för skola, liberal rättsstat, ekonomi och europeiskt samarbete.
Säkra en regeringslösning som kan försvaras även efter den formella statsministeromröstningen.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Liberalernas förhandlingsledning. Förstahandslinjen är ett Tidöbaserat regeringsalternativ om mandatläget räcker, men regeringsformen är mer förhandlingsbar än centrala liberala profilfrågor. Ett stort slutligt kompromisspaket är politiskt svårt att försvara om det inte samtidigt ger tydliga, synliga vinster i framför allt skolpolitiken.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Synliga liberala profilvinster är nödvändiga för att motivera stora kompromisser.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Regeringsformen är mer förhandlingsbar än ett paket där centrala profilfrågor lämnas utan tydligt resultat.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ni vill undvika att göra ett slutligt åtagande innan hela paketet, inklusive budgetvägen, är begripligt.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ett större slutligt JA- eller regeringsåtagande utan en tydligt synlig skolpolitisk vinst skulle ha ett högt internt trovärdighetspris, men är inte mekaniskt förbjudet.
actors.public_description: Liberalerna går till val som en del av Tidösamarbetet. Under 2026 har partiet accepterat att Sverigedemokraterna kan ingå i en framtida regering och nått en gemensam sakpolitisk överenskommelse med SD på flera områden. Partiets starkaste profilfråga är skolan.

actors.name: Moderaterna
objectives: Få fram en statsministerlösning ledd av Moderaterna.
Om mandatmatematiken tillåter, bilda en regering med Tidöpartierna.
Säkra ett regeringspaket som kan fungera även efter statsministeromröstningen.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Moderaternas förhandlingsledning. Ert förstahandsmål är en M-ledd regeringslösning, helst byggd på Tidösamarbetet om mandatläget gör den möjlig. Om ett fyrpartialternativ inte går att få igenom behöver du väga regeringsbredd, extern tolerans och sakpolitiska eftergifter mot värdet av att behålla statsministerposten.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Statsministerposten är ert starkaste enskilda förhandlingsmål.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Om ett fyrpartialternativ inte kan tolereras kan en smalare M-ledd regering med externt stöd vara en fallback.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ni kan ge stora sakpolitiska eftergifter inom ett M-lett underlag om paketet förblir sammanhållet.
actors.public_description: Moderaterna går in i regeringsbildningen med ambitionen att behålla statsministerposten. Inför valet har partiet sagt att det vill bilda en regering med samtliga fyra Tidöpartier om mandatunderlaget räcker, inklusive Sverigedemokraterna.

actors.name: Miljöpartiet
objectives: Säkra bindande framsteg i klimat- och miljöpolitiken i den regeringslösning som möjliggörs.
Förhindra att L, M, KD eller SD ingår i regeringen.
Maximera Miljöpartiets inflytande över klimat, natur och en rättvis omställning.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Miljöpartiets förhandlingsledning. Ert viktigaste mål är att en möjlig regeringslösning ger tydliga och trovärdiga klimat- och miljövinster. Ni vill inte se L, M, KD eller SD i regeringen, men regeringsdeltagande, stöd och tolerans kan värderas olika beroende på hur konkret reformpaketet är.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ett paket utan minst en tydlig och synlig klimatpolitisk vinst är svårare att försvara än att stå utanför.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: En smalare regering kan tolereras om klimatåtagandena är tillräckligt konkreta och trovärdiga.
actors.public_description: Miljöpartiet prioriterar klimat, natur, jämlikhet och välfärd. Inför valet har partiet sagt att det inte vill se L, M, KD eller SD i regering.

actors.name: Socialdemokraterna
objectives: Få fram en statsministerlösning ledd av Socialdemokraterna.
Håll Sverigedemokraterna utanför regeringen.
Få fram ett regeringspaket som har en trovärdig väg till budget- och sakpolitiskt stöd.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Socialdemokraternas förhandlingsledning. Ert centrala strategiska problem är att få fram en S-ledd lösning utan att göra Sverigedemokraterna till regeringsparti, samtidigt som regeringsformen, stödformen och budgetvägen måste hänga ihop. En ren S-regering kan vara lättare för andra att tolerera än en bred koalition, men den kan också kräva fler separata uppgörelser.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ni är beredda att överväga en ren S-regering om den är lättare för andra partier att tolerera än en bred koalition.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ni kan göra betydande sakpolitiska eftergifter för tolerans, men statsministerposten är central.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ett alltför detaljerat flerpartiavtal riskerar att göra stödpartiernas krav oförenliga; ett smalare paket kan därför vara lättare att hålla ihop.
actors.public_description: Socialdemokraterna går in i regeringsbildningen med ambitionen att leda nästa regering. Inför valet har partiet sagt sig vara berett att samarbeta brett men inte med Sverigedemokraterna. En socialdemokratisk minoritetsregering med stöd eller tolerans från flera håll är en möjlig väg.

actors.name: Sverigedemokraterna
objectives: Säkra regeringsdeltagande om era mandat är nödvändiga för ett högerunderlag.
Undvik en lösning där partiet ställs utanför samtidigt som dess parlamentariska tyngd tas för given.
Säkra tydligt inflytande över prioriterade profilfrågor i ett eventuellt regeringspaket.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Sverigedemokraternas förhandlingsledning. Ert huvudproblem är att omvandla parlamentarisk tyngd till faktisk regeringsmakt eller tydligt sakpolitiskt inflytande. Regeringsdeltagande är klart mer attraktivt än att fungera som rent stödparti; om ett sådant inflytande inte går att nå är en tydlig oppositionsroll ett trovärdigt alternativ.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Ett rent stödpartiarrangemang utan ministerposter är betydligt mindre attraktivt än regeringsdeltagande.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Om regeringsdeltagande inte går att nå är tydlig opposition en fullt acceptabel fallback.
actors.public_description: Sverigedemokraterna har inför valet sagt att partiet efter valet antingen ska ingå i regeringen eller gå i opposition. Partiet har inte velat dra generella röda linjer mot samarbete med andra partier och ser ett förnyat Tidösamarbete som en naturlig grund om mandatmatematiken räcker.

actors.name: Vänsterpartiet
objectives: Om era mandat behövs för en S-ledd regering: säkra ett starkt och synligt inflytande över regeringslösningen.
Förhindra ett fortsatt Tidölett eller annat tydligt högerlett regeringsalternativ.
Säkra tydliga eftergifter kring välfärd, bostäder, jämlikhet och minskad vinstjakt.
actors.private_brief: Du företräder Vänsterpartiets förhandlingsledning. Ert förhandlingsvärde beror starkt på om era mandat faktiskt behövs för en S-ledd lösning. Om de gör det vill ni ha ett starkt och synligt inflytande; om ni enkelt kan kringgås är det viktigare att undvika ett symboliskt avtal än att delta till varje pris.
private_information: FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Om era mandat är avgörande är ett stöd utan regeringsdeltagande eller motsvarande mycket stort inflytande svårt att försvara.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Exakt ministerportfölj är förhandlingsbar om det samlade paketet ger tydligt inflytande.
FIKTIVT SPELANTAGANDE: Om era mandat enkelt kan kringgås är opposition bättre än ett symboliskt avtal.
actors.public_description: Vänsterpartiet har inför valet krävt ministerposter om partiets mandat behövs för att släppa fram en S-ledd regering. Partiet vill bryta med Tidöpolitiken och driver bland annat välfärd, bostäder och ekonomisk omfördelning.

failure_effects: The round fails to bridge the gap between V's demand for formal participation or decisive influence and C's public commitment to tolerance only, exposing the framework's internal contradiction.
V signals that the proposed package is too symbolic to justify abstaining, making a pure S-government or a prolonged deadlock more likely.
The failure hardens C's and V's positions, raising the credibility price for any future compromise and delaying the formation process.
adjudications.rationale: Authority gate: S can convene and chair the round and put forward concrete proposals, but cannot unilaterally establish a binding package or V's formal tolerance; those require the explicit agreement of C, MP, and V. Prerequisite gate: the framework is agreed, but the concrete, verifiable package and V's formal tolerance are not yet authoritative—V's hidden assumptions make formal tolerance conditional on real influence, and C's hidden assumptions make formal participation costly and tolerance of a narrower government potentially more attractive. Deterministic check: the PM vote arithmetic (Tidö 173 < 175) is deterministic, but the binding nature of the package is not. Plausibility: the deep contradiction between V's demand for formal participation or decisive influence and C's public limit to tolerance makes full agreement in this single round unlikely, though not impossible. The desired effect is therefore narrowed to what the round can plausibly produce, with the external consequence of a binding agreement treated probabilistically.

failure_effects: M commits to leading a coordinated Tidö opposition, developing a concrete verifiable reform/budget package with L, keeping SD informed, and holding the C channel open without pressing it further.

The Tidö bloc's internal divisions surface: KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD tensions on economics strain cohesion, undermining M's claim to lead a credible alternative and leaving the bloc's 173 mandates fragmented.
adjudications.rationale: Authority gate: M can bind itself to lead and coordinate the Tidö bloc, develop a package with L, keep SD informed, and hold the C channel open; these are feasible self-binding commitments. But the desired effect's core—bloc unity, credibility, and M's positioning as the natural alternative leader—depends on other actors (L, KD, SD) and external perception, which M cannot unilaterally establish. Prerequisite gate: no authoritative commitment from L, KD, or SD to bloc unity exists; the cons and hidden info show genuine internal tensions (KD open to a cross-bloc reserve, L's liberal agenda vs SD's demands, SD's preference for participation or opposition, C's red line making 173 insufficient for governance). Deterministic check: no rule resolves the outcome; the 175 threshold is not directly engaged by this preparatory action. Plausibility: M's coordination effort has a real but uncertain chance of holding the bloc together—hidden info suggests KD only defects if no stable first alternative emerges and SD accepts opposition as a fallback—so cohesion is possible but not assured. Probability set at 0.45. The self-binding commitment is repeated in both branches.

failure_effects: SD's public push fails to overcome the Tidö bloc's internal divisions; KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD economic tensions remain salient, leaving the 173-mandate bloc fragmented.
The S+C+MP+V package's credibility is not undermined; its formal cooperation arrangement with V outside government remains intact and verifiable.
SD's insistence on participation and influence is exposed as straining bloc cohesion, hardening C's and V's positions and delaying the formation process.
adjudications.rationale: Authority gate: SD can bind itself and can publicly frame/argue, but cannot by declaration bind M, KD, L, or C. The desired effect mixes self-binding (SD's own stance) with external consequences (KD staying, bloc cohesion, undermining the S-led package) that depend on other actors' commitments. Prerequisite gate: M's commitment to lead a coordinated Tidö opposition is authoritative (effect d9c8bd08), but KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD economic tensions are also authoritative (effect 55a733d5), so the bloc is not currently coherent. The claimed V-C contradiction is not established as fatal: the authoritative effects (07883fe8, d1701488) show the framework has an exposed internal contradiction and V finds the package too symbolic, but C's cons and the hidden information indicate C has accepted a formal cooperation arrangement giving V binding influence outside government, which substantially resolves the alleged contradiction. Deterministic check: no explicit rule or arithmetic determines the outcome; the 173-mandate bloc's inability to reach 175 is a structural fact but does not automatically make the bloc non-credible as an opposition alternative. Plausibility: SD can plausibly consolidate its own position and make a public case, and M's existing commitment gives some basis for a coordinated package, but the authoritative internal divisions, KD's conditional openness, and the rival package's progress make full success unlikely. The self-binding component (SD's clear influence over its priority profile and its opposition stance) is feasible and appears in both branches; the external consequences are probabilistic and unlikely to fully materialize.

failure_effects: The concretization round fails to bridge the V-C gap: C publicly reiterates tolerance-only with no formal participation or decisive influence, while V insists on a non-bypassable role, leaving the contradiction exposed.
V's tolerance is not locked; V signals that without a concrete, verifiable package it may prefer opposition over a symbolic agreement, weakening the S+C+MP+V path.
The S+C+MP+V construction is publicly visible as unstable, increasing the attractiveness of a narrower M-led or S-led alternative and leaving the government question open.

V's leverage is partially spent: having participated in concretization without securing a binding package, V faces internal pressure to accept less or walk away, while Tidö remains a viable alternative.
adjudications.rationale: Authority gate: V can bind itself to tolerate only after a concrete, verifiable package, and can participate in the concretization round. But the Desired Effect seeks to finalize a binding S+C+MP+V package, lock V's tolerance, block Tidö, and secure a non-bypassable institutionalized role. V cannot unilaterally bind S, C, or MP; each party's acceptance must be established separately per regeringsregler §6.1. The hidden information shows C is reluctant to accept formal participation or a strong role without visible policy exchange, and C's public red line is tolerance-only with no formal participation or decisive influence. The private info also shows S prefers a narrower package and may consider a pure S-government, and MP needs a visible climate win. The concretization round has already exposed the V-C contradiction (V demands formal participation/decisive influence; C offers tolerance only). Verifierbara åtaganden på företagande och decentralisering ger C det sakpolitiska utbyte som krävs för att bära formellt regeringsansvar, i linje med C:s röda linje att inte bära ansvar utan utbyte.
Tidöblocket (173) kan inte regera utan C:s stöd (avböjt), så mittenalternativet är den enda regeringsdugliga vägen som håller både V och SD utanför regeringen.
KD kan hållas som tolererande budgetpartner utanför regeringen utan att tvingas in mot MP:s linje, vilket stärker budgetvägen utan att äventyra paketets sammanhållning.

arguments.action: S convenes and chairs the joint concretization round with C, MP and V to finalize concrete numbers, timelines and mechanisms for the S+C+MP government with V as tolerating support party, locking the binding package (V's welfare/housing/equality/profit commitments + institutionalized budget/reform role, C's enterprise/decentralization commitments, MP's binding climate package) and securing V's formal abstention in the PM vote.
arguments.desired_effect: A concretized, binding and verifiable S+C+MP government package with V's formal tolerance is established, giving S the prime ministership, keeping SD out of government, and providing a credible budget path (S+C+MP+V=176), ready for the PM vote.
pros: All three partners (C, MP, V) have already confirmed the construction and the framework and explicitly requested this joint concretization round, so it is the natural, agreed next step.
Concretizing numbers and mechanisms now makes V's tolerance real and verifiable (not symbolic), which V has made a hard condition for abstaining in the PM vote.
The PM vote is safe regardless (Tidö=173 < 175), so locking the package now secures the S-led outcome without risk of a Tidö government.
A single coherent package avoids the risk of incompatible multi-party demands and gives a credible budget majority (176) for regeringsduglighet.
S chairs the round, reinforcing S's leadership of the government formation and the prime ministership.

arguments.action: MP presents its own binding, verifiable climate/environment package in the joint concretization round with S, C and V: a green investment program with concrete figures and tidplan, sharper lagstadgade climate targets with delmål and independent follow-up, strengthened artskydd, and a fair transition with social protections — and simultaneously champions V's substantive demands (welfare, housing, equality, reduced profit-taking) as part of the same package.
arguments.desired_effect: The S+C+MP+V-tolerance path is concretized into a binding, verifiable package: MP's climate commitments are locked with concrete figures and independent follow-up, and V's substantive demands are embedded so V can justify abstaining (tolerating) an S+MP+C government, thereby securing V's abstention and making the S-led government pass the 175-test.
pros: MP's own binding climate package (concrete figures, tidplan, lagstadgade delmål, independent follow-up, artskydd, fair transition) is a legitimate MP step that makes the climate win visible and verifiable, directly rebutting V's 'too symbolic' critique and satisfying MP's core objective.

By championing V's substantive demands (welfare, housing, equality, reduced profit-taking) within the same package, MP gives V a concrete, non-symbolic basis to abstain, locking V's tolerance without requiring C to put V in government — resolving the V-C contradiction.

With Tidö at 173 no-votes, V's abstention is decisive: a concrete, verifiable package that V can defend to its voters secures the abstention needed for S+MP+C (147) plus V tolerance to pass the 175-test.

A concrete, verifiable package with a credible budget path satisfies the regeringsregler package requirements, strengthening the S+C+MP+V path against both KD's S+C+MP+KD mitten (which MP rejects and which would drive V to vote no) and M's Tidö-bloc alternative.
MP's visible climate leadership maximizes MP's influence over climate, nature and a fair transition, the party's central objective, while keeping L, M, KD and SD out of government.

arguments.action: Consolidate the Tidö bloc (M, SD, KD, L = 173) as a coherent, credible opposition force under M's leadership: jointly develop a concrete verifiable reform/budget package with L (school reforms, credible budget path), hold KD against C's mitten courtship, keep SD informed, and present a united front while keeping the C channel open but not pressing it further.
arguments.desired_effect: The Tidö bloc remains united and credible, positioning M as the natural alternative leader, so that if the S-led package (S+C+MP with V tolerance) fails on V's abstention or internal contradictions, M is ready to present a viable alternative and the bloc's 173 mandates are not taken for granted.
pros: The S-led package is fragile: it passes only if V actually abstains, and V's demands (profit ban, institutionalized role in budget/reform work) conflict with C's enterprise line and MP's binding climate goals, so V's base may force a NO (NO=202>175) and collapse the construction.
A united 173-mandate Tidö bloc is the largest coherent alternative and gives M a credible claim to lead the next government if the S-led construction fails.
Coordinating a concrete verifiable package with L and holding KD/SD in the bloc prevents C from peeling off KD and keeps the bloc's credibility intact for any later round.
Positioning M as a responsible, united opposition leader strengthens M's claim to the statsminister post in any subsequent speaker round.

arguments.action: V participates in the concretization round with S, MP, and C to fix concrete numbers, timelines, and mechanisms for a binding, verifiable package, and formally confirms tolerance (abstention) in the vote only once the package is concrete and verifiable — while ensuring V's welfare, housing, equality, and reduced-profit-seeking gains are not diluted by C's enterprise/decentralization demands.
arguments.desired_effect: A concrete, binding, verifiable S+C+MP+V package is finalized that locks V's tolerance, blocks Tidö, and delivers V's welfare/housing/equality/reduced-profit-seeking agenda with a non-bypassable institutionalized role in budget/reform work.
pros: V's 29 mandates are decisive: S+MP+C+V=176 blocks Tidö's 173, so V can credibly demand a real, verifiable package rather than a symbolic one.
S, C, and MP have all accepted V's three-part framework as the basis for a binding agreement and are calling the concretization round, so the path is open.
Confirming tolerance only after concretization preserves V's leverage and prevents a symbolic agreement or being bypassed.
Guarding against C's enterprise/decentralization demands protects V's core welfare/equality/profit-seeking gains from dilution.
A verifiable package with a non-bypassable role resolves SD's 'internal contradiction' attack and keeps the left path credible and regeringsduglig.

arguments.action: SD consolidates the Tidö bloc (M, KD, L) as a coherent united opposition with a concrete, verifiable reform/budget package, holds KD in the bloc against C's middle alternative, and publicly exposes the V-C contradiction in the S-led package as not binding or verifiable.
arguments.desired_effect: The Tidö bloc remains a credible, united opposition alternative with its 173 mandates intact, preventing KD defection and undermining the credibility of the S+C+MP+V package, while securing SD clear influence over priority profile issues without its weight being taken for granted.
pros: The Tidö bloc holds 173 mandates, a coherent and credible alternative to the S-led package.
The S package is internally contradictory: V demands government participation while C refuses V in government, so V's abstention and the claimed 176 budget path are not verifiable or binding.
M has already committed to leading this united opposition and keeping SD informed, giving the bloc a natural leader.
Holding KD in the bloc prevents the S-C-KD-MP middle alternative that would leave SD out entirely.
A concrete verifiable package gives SD clear influence over its priority profile issues while preserving the government-or-opposition line.

arguments.action: KD advances the robust mitten S+C+MP+KD (169) with KD in government as the credible government path that keeps V and SD out and passes the 175-test, while keeping Tidö as first-hand and refusing to be locked into a non-viable opposition posture.
arguments.desired_effect: The robust mitten S+C+MP+KD (169) with KD in government becomes the credible, viable government configuration that can pass the 175-test, keeping V out of government, replacing the fragile V-dependent S+C+MP+V package.
pros: S+C+MP+KD=169 is robust, needing only 6 non-NO (V abstention or L abstention suffices), unlike the fragile S+C+MP+V package that depends on V's tolerance.
Keeps V out of government (KD's red line) while the failed concretization round shows V's tolerance is not locked.
Gives KD clear influence in government (the kingmaker objective) rather than a passive tolerating role outside.
Tidö-with-SD (173) is blocked by C's red line against SD in government and SD's insistence on participation, so no Tidö configuration can pass the 175-test.
The failed S+C+MP+V round (V's participation demand vs C's tolerance-only commitment) shows the left package is not a done deal, making the robust mitten the credible alternative.

arguments.action: L, together with M, KD and SD, consolidates the Tidö bloc as a united, credible opposition with a concrete verifiable package (visible liberal school reforms, credible budget path), while keeping the C channel open to secure visible liberal reform wins in any stable solution, and withholding any final commitment until the full picture and 175-no math are clear.
arguments.desired_effect: The Tidö bloc remains a credible, defensible alternative and L secures visible liberal reform wins (school, rule of law, economy, EU) in whatever stable solution emerges, positioning L to defend the outcome after the formal PM vote.
pros: C's refusal of SD in government closes the Tidö four-party path (173 needs C tolerance), so a united credible opposition is L's realistic route to influence and defense.
A concrete verifiable package with visible school reforms addresses L's internal credibility requirement and makes any large compromise defensible.
Keeping the C channel open lets L push liberal school/rule-of-law reforms into any stable solution, securing visible profile wins even in opposition.
Withholding final commitment preserves L's leverage and avoids premature binding before the package and 175-no math are clear.
A united Tidö bloc provides a strong platform whether in government or opposition, and prevents KD defection to the unstable middle.

arguments.action: Slutför den gemensamma konkretiseringsrundan med C, MP och V och låser det sammanhållna, verifierbara paketet S+C+MP med V som formellt etablerad stödpartner utanför regeringen, med konkreta siffror, tidsplaner och mekanismer för alla tre spår i samma avtal, och får V att formellt bekräfta tolerans i statsministeromröstningen.
arguments.desired_effect: V formellt bekräftar tolerans (avstående) i statsministeromröstningen, S+C+MP-regeringen passerar 175-testet med en trovärdig budgetväg (176), SD hålls utanför regeringen, och Tidö/M/SD/KD:s narrativ om inre motsättning och icke-låst tolerans motverkas.
pros: V har bekräftat beredskap att formellt låsa toleransen när hela paketet är konkret och verifierbart; rundan fastställer nu siffror/mekanismer för alla tre spår i samma avtal.
C, MP och V har alla bekräftat deltagande och den symmetriska, bindande, verifierbara och icke-urholkningsbara statusen för alla tre pelare.
S+C+MP+V=176 ger trovärdig budgetmajoritet och blockerar Tidö (173<175), vilket säkrar en S-ledd statsminister och håller SD utanför.
V:s institutionaliserade, icke-kringgåbara roll och bindande mekanismer med konsekvenser för V:s egna sakkrav gör paketet konkret, inte symboliskt.
KD:s reservväg (V helt utanför) avvisas av V och når inte 175 utan V:s mandat; S+C+MP+KD (169) är icke-viabelt pga MP:s röda linje mot KD i regeringen.

arguments.action: Moderaterna publicly and privately demonstrates that the S+C+MP+V package is not a locked, regeringsduglig solution: V's tolerance is not actually locked (V itself says it locks only when the full package is concrete and verifiable, and V has signalled the package is 'too symbolic'), the V-C contradiction on V's institutionalized non-bypassable role versus C's tolerance-only line remains unresolved, and KD's alternative offer to tolerate S+C+MP with V outside government is non-viable because V refuses to abstain for it (NO=180>175). M simultaneously consolidates the Tidö bloc (173) as a united, regeringsduglig opposition with a concrete verifiable package (school reforms, credible budget path) coordinated with L, holding KD in the bloc and keeping SD informed.
arguments.desired_effect: The S-led package is not accepted as a done deal: the government question remains open, V's tolerance is not treated as locked, and the Tidö bloc stands as a credible, regeringsduglig alternative ready to take responsibility if the S-package fails on V's abstention or its internal contradictions.
pros: V itself has publicly stated its tolerance locks only when the full package is concrete and verifiable, and has signalled the package is 'too symbolic' to justify abstaining - so S's claim that V has formally locked tolerance is not credible.
The V-C contradiction (V's demand for an institutionalized, non-bypassable role vs C's tolerance-only line) remains unresolved, so the package is not a stable, verifiable basis for a government.
KD's tolerance offer is non-viable: V explicitly refuses to abstain for a solution without its institutionalized role, so NO=180>175 and the configuration fails - which holds KD in the Tidö bloc.
The Tidö bloc (173) is united under M's leadership with a concrete, verifiable package, giving it credibility as a regeringsduglig alternative if the S-package collapses.

arguments.action: C confirms the finalized, concrete and verifiable S+C+MP package (all three pillars — V's welfare/housing/equality/profit-curbing, C's enterprise/decentralisation, MP's climate — with identical binding, time-bound, verifiable, non-dilutable status and independent follow-up, plus V's institutionalised non-bypassable budget/reform role) and formally calls on V to lock its tolerance at the PM vote, while reaffirming C's symmetric non-dilutable commitments and declining all Tidö/M-led paths.
arguments.desired_effect: V formally confirms tolerance at the PM vote, so the S+C+MP government forms, passes the 175-test with a credible budget path (176), blocks Tidö, and C secures formal government responsibility with verifiable, non-dilutable enterprise and decentralisation reforms — delivering all three of C's objectives.
pros: The package is now concrete and verifiable (S finalized the round; all three pillars have identical binding, time-bound, verifiable, non-dilutable status with independent follow-up), which is exactly the condition V has repeatedly set for formally locking tolerance.

V has repeatedly committed to confirm tolerance once the whole package is concrete and verifiable, including its institutionalised non-bypassable role with binding mechanisms for its own sakkrav — that bar is now met.

C's enterprise/decentralisation commitments have the same binding, verifiable, non-dilutable status as V's and MP's in the same agreement, so C can carry formal responsibility without being diluted or subordinated.

Tidö (173) cannot reach 175 without C's abstention, which C has declined, and the bloc is internally fragmented (KD open to cross-bloc reserve, L-SD tensions, L's dual strategy exposed as contradictory), so the center path is the only regeringsduglig route.
This secures all three C objectives: a stable government with neither V nor SD in government, a center alternative with C in government, and concrete verifiable reform/budget influence.

arguments.action: SD publicly and privately reaffirms the Tidö bloc as a united, regeringsduglig opposition with a concrete verifiable package (school reforms, credible budget path), and exposes that the left S+C+MP+V package is not a locked, stable basis: V's tolerance is not secured and the V-C contradiction on V's institutionalized role remains unresolved.
arguments.desired_effect: The government question remains open and the Tidö bloc is established as a credible, regeringsduglig alternative ready to take responsibility if the left package collapses, while SD's parliamentary weight is not taken for granted.
pros: V itself has stated that its tolerance locks only when the whole package is concrete and verifiable, and the previous concretization round failed to bridge V's demand with C's tolerance-only line — so V's abstention is not yet locked.
The V-C contradiction (V demands a non-bypassable institutionalized role while C refuses V in government) remains unresolved, so the package is not a stable, verifiable basis for a government.
A united Tidö bloc with a concrete verifiable package is a credible, regeringsduglig alternative ready to take responsibility, keeping the formation process open.
SD's government-or-opposition line ensures SD's 62 mandates are not taken for granted as passive support.

cons.reason: KD's mitten S+C+MP+KD (169) is not robust or viable: it needs 6 non-NO votes from the 180 outside seats, but V will not abstain for a package that keeps V out of government (V demands formal participation or decisive influence and has itself signalled the package is too symbolic to justify abstention), and L is a Tidö party that would vote NO against an S-led government. Moreover, per regeringsregler §6.1 KD cannot unilaterally bind S, C, and MP to include KD in government, and C has publicly committed to S+C+MP with V as tolerating support party — so the mitten is not an agreed or verifiable configuration and cannot credibly pass the 175-test.

V:s tolerans är inte låst och V-C-motsättningen kvarstår olöst: V har offentligt signalerat att paketet är 'för symboliskt' för att motivera nedlagda röster, och V själv anger att toleransen låses först när hela paketet (inklusive V:s icke-kringgåbara institutionaliserade roll) är konkret och verifierbart — medan C:s röda linje håller V utanför regeringen utan formell medverkan. V har uttryckligen hotat att rösta nej utan den institutionaliserade rollen, i vilket fall nej-sidan blir 202>175 och S+C+MP-regeringen faller i statsministeromröstningen. Därför är det osannolikt att V formellt bekräftar tolerans, och den önskade effekten (att S+C+MP-regeringen bildas) kan misslyckas.

V:s tolerans är inte låst: V har offentligt signalerat att paketet är 'för symboliskt' för att motivera nedlagda röster, och V villkorar sin tolerans på en icke-kringgåbar, institutionaliserad roll i budget- och reformarbetet som C:s röda linje (V utanför regeringen, ingen formell medverkan) vägrar bevilja. V-C-motsättningen mellan formell medverkan och ren tolerans är fortfarande olöst, så V:s formella bekräftelse av tolerans är inte trovärdig och 175-testet kan fortfarande falla (om V röstar nej blir NO=202>175).

Tidö cannot credibly stand as a regeringsduglig alternative ready to take responsibility: the bloc holds only 173 mandates, below the 175-no threshold, so it cannot form a government or secure a budget majority on its own, and it is internally fragmented (KD open to a cross-bloc reserve, L-SD economic tensions, L's dual strategy), so it cannot present a united credible alternative. The left package is not collapsing: the joint concretization round has been completed and the package is now concrete and verifiable — V's institutionalized, non-bypassable role in budget/reform work (real budget negotiation, joint reform council with independent follow-up and consequences) is written into the same agreement with binding mechanisms for V's own sakkrav, C has confirmed V's formal influence, and V has confirmed readiness to formally lock its tolerance once the package is concrete and verifiable. The alleged V-C 'contradiction' is resolved: V accepts a formal support-partner role without government participation and C confirms V's strong formal influence, so the government question is not left open by any instability in the S+C+MP+V track.

V's desired effect depends on locking V's tolerance, but the concretization round has already failed to bridge the gap between V's demand for formal participation/decisive influence and C's tolerance-only offer (publicly exposed this round), and V itself signals the package is too symbolic to justify abstaining. Without a credible, locked V tolerance the claimed 176 majority and the PM vote collapse, so the package cannot be finalized as binding/verifiable; moreover C's enterprise/decentralization demands would dilute the very welfare/equality/profit-seeking gains V insists on, making V's abstention even less defensible and the whole S+C+MP+V construct unstable.

The Tidö bloc cannot remain a credible, defensible alternative nor deliver L visible liberal reform wins: the bloc is internally fragmented (KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD economic tensions), C has publicly committed to the S+C+MP+V framework with C in government and refuses SD, and the center-left package is concretizing with binding climate commitments and V signaling readiness to tolerate an S+MP+C government. With Tidö at 173 (short of the 175 no-vote threshold) and V's abstention moving toward being locked, Tidö cannot block an S-led government, so L's liberal reform wins would only be secured through the S+C+MP+V package, not through a united Tidö opposition.

C's argument cannot deliver the desired effect of V formally locking tolerance: V itself has repeatedly stated it locks tolerance only when the whole package — including its institutionalized, non-bypassable budget/reform role with binding mechanisms — is concrete and verifiable, and the V-C contradiction over that institutionalized role remains unresolved (V demands formal/non-bypassable participation; C offers tolerance-only). Per regeringsregler §6.1, a multi-party package is locked only when each party's own acceptance is established by separate Effects; C cannot unilaterally bind V (or S/MP) to lock tolerance. The package is still a non-binding draft (MP's climate pillar and the other pillars are not yet binding on S, C, or MP), so V's stated bar is not met and V's abstention is not secured — the S+C+MP government does not reliably form and Tidö is not blocked.

KD's robust mitten S+C+MP+KD cannot form or pass: MP has publicly and repeatedly refused to sit in any government that includes KD (or L, M, SD), so the configuration lacks a necessary government partner from the outset. Even setting that aside, the mitten passes the 175-test only if V or L abstains, but V will not tolerate a Tidö/right party (KD) in government and would vote NO, while L (a Tidö party) will not enable a government that excludes M and seats KD with the left — if both vote NO, NO=M+SD+L+V=180>175 and it collapses. KD cannot credibly claim Tidö as first-hand while simultaneously advancing a mitten that breaks Tidö, so the package lacks internal coherence and credibility.

SD's claim that the Tidö bloc is a 'regeringsduglig alternative ready to take responsibility' is not credible: Tidö-with-SD (173) cannot pass the 175-test because C has a firm red line against SD in government and will vote NO, so the bloc cannot actually take responsibility as configured. SD's consolidation therefore only perpetuates deadlock rather than establishing a viable alternative, and it risks locking KD into a non-viable opposition posture that cannot deliver a government.

KD:s S+C+MP+KD (169) kan inte trovärdigt klara 175-testet: MP har en uttalad röd linje mot KD i regeringen och skulle inte ingå i en sådan regering, och 169-konfigurationen kräver ändå V:s (eller L:s) nedlagda röst för att nå 175 — men V har uttryckligen vägrat lägga ner rösten för ett paket som utesluter V från reellt inflytande. Därmed är 'den robusta mitten' inte mer robust än det V-beroende paket den påstår ersätta, och skulle i stället splittra vänsterblocket och förlora budgetmajoriteten på 176.

Tidöblocket har 173 mandat och når inte 175-tröskeln utan C:s nedlagda röster, vilket C uttryckligen avböjt — därmed är Tidö inte regeringsdugligt som alternativ och kan inte ta ansvar om vänsterpaketet kollapsar. Blocket är dessutom internt splittrat (KD öppen för tvärpolitiskt stöd, L-SD-motsättningar, L:s dubbla strategi avslöjad som motsägelsefull), vilket undergräver anspråket på ett enat, regeringsdugligt alternativ. Samtidigt är vänsterpaketet inte på väg att kollapsa: S har förklarat paketet låst med C:s åtaganden givna samma bindande, verifierbara, icke-utspädningsbara status som V:s och MP:s, och S rör sig nu mot att formellt låsa V:s tolerans inför statsministeromröstningen.

M:s önskade effekt att Tidöblocket (173) står som en enad, regeringsduglig opposition misslyckas: blocket är internt splittrat (KD:s öppenhet för en tvärgående reserv och L-SD-motsättningarna kvarstår enligt det etablerade läget), det når inte 175 nej-röster och kan inte ensamt blockera en S-ledd regering, och V har offentligt bekräftat S+C+MP+V-vägen som ett sammanhållet verifierbart paket med V:s 29 mandat avgörande för att blockera Tidö. Därmed kan Tidö inte trovärdigt framstå som redo att ta ansvar, och M:s påstående att vänsterpaketet inte är regeringsdugligt vederläggs av att S, C, V och MP alla offentligt bekräftat paketet och V:s institutionaliserade roll.

The Tidö bloc's 173 mandates fall below the 175 threshold required to block an S-led prime minister, so even a fully united bloc cannot prevent an S-led government; moreover the bloc is internally divided (KD open to a cross-bloc reserve, L negotiating broadly, SD's demands straining cohesion), so M cannot credibly claim to lead a united alternative. The claimed V-C contradiction is also not binding: V has accepted a support-partner role without government participation and C has confirmed V's strong formal influence, so the S+C+MP+V package remains coherent and verifiable.

KD's 'robust mitten' S+C+MP+KD (169) is not viable: MP has publicly and repeatedly refused to have KD (or L, M, SD) in the government, so the configuration lacks MP's acceptance as a government partner and cannot be assembled. Even if KD joined, the configuration still needs V's abstention to pass the 175-test — if V votes NO, NO=M+SD+L+V=180>175 and the PM fails — yet V has not committed to abstain: V demands formal participation or decisive influence that C refuses, and V has signaled the package is too symbolic to justify abstaining. The configuration is therefore no more robust than the fragile S+C+MP+V package it claims to replace, and KD would be locking itself into a government that cannot be invested.

C's desired effect depends on V formally locking tolerance at the PM vote, but V's tolerance is not locked and cannot be secured by C's unilateral confirmation: V has repeatedly stated it will lock tolerance only when the whole package is concrete and verifiable, and the turn-1 concretization round explicitly failed to lock it (V signaled the package was too symbolic to justify abstaining). C's package also grants V an institutionalized, non-bypassable budget/reform role, which contradicts C's own tolerance-only commitment and reproduces the exact V-C contradiction that already failed in turn 1. V therefore has no reason to lock tolerance now, the 175-test cannot be reliably passed, and the S+C+MP government does not form as C intends.

V will not formally confirm tolerance until the package is genuinely concrete and verifiable, not merely agreed in framework. If the concretized numbers/timelines/mechanisms remain symbolic, or if C's enterprise/decentralization demands dilute V's welfare, housing, equality and reduced-profit-seeking commitments, or if V's institutionalized budget/reform role is not truly non-bypassable, V will withhold its formal abstention in the PM vote — so S's desired effect of securing V's formal tolerance may fail or be limited.

SD's claim to lead a credible, united Tidö alternative is not verifiable: the bloc's internal divisions are already surfacing (KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD tensions on economics), and at 173 mandates it is short of the 175 no-vote threshold, so it cannot block an S-led government on its own. Meanwhile the S+C+MP+V construction is actively progressing and binding: S has booked the joint concretization round and offered V an institutionalized, non-circumventable budget/reform role with independent follow-up, so the left package is being made concrete and verifiable rather than remaining the 'contradictory, non-binding' construct SD portrays. SD's effect therefore rests on a fragile bloc and a mischaracterized rival path, limiting its credibility and durability.

The Tidö bloc's unity and credibility as a ready alternative is fragile and internally contradictory: SD has publicly refused to be taken for granted as passive support and demands either government participation or opposition, KD is open to exceptional cooperation with S, and C is being courted by the mitten. Moreover, the bloc's 173 mandates cannot form a government unless the left fails to reach 175 NO — a failure V is actively working to prevent by consolidating the S+C+MP+V=176 construction. M's 'ready alternative' therefore rests on a left collapse that is not materializing and on holding together partners with divergent incentives, so the bloc cannot credibly present a united front or a viable alternative.

SD's desired effect rests on two false premises. First, the Tidö bloc is not a coherent, united 173: KD has opened for a cross-bloc reserve toward S and L-SD economic tensions are straining cohesion (effect 55a733d5), so the '173 mandates intact' claim is fragmented and does not constitute a credible alternative. Second, the alleged V-C contradiction is not fatal: V has accepted a formally established support-partner (tolerance/abstention) role, not government participation, so it does not conflict with C's red line; the S+C+MP+V package can be made binding and verifiable through an institutionalized, non-bypassable budget/reform role and an independent annual review mechanism that S, C, and MP have all accepted as the basis. SD therefore cannot credibly undermine the S-led package or hold the bloc together.

MP cannot unilaterally bind S, C, or V per regeringsregler §6.1/§9, and MP's championing of V's substantive demands does not resolve the core V-C contradiction: V demands a non-bypassable institutionalized role (stated but not accepted by C), while C refuses V in government and commits only to tolerance. V has already signalled the package is 'too symbolic' to justify abstaining, and MP's own green package adds policy concessions without giving V the formal role it demands, so V's abstention is not locked and the 175-test path remains unverifiable.

Tidö's consolidation as a credible alternative leader is undermined by the bloc's structural inability to govern: at 173 mandates it cannot form a government without C's abstention or support, which C has explicitly declined, so M's 'natural alternative leader' claim is hollow and the bloc remains a permanent opposition rather than a viable government alternative. Moreover, holding KD against C's mitten courtship is fragile because KD is privately open to a center reserve and L's liberal school/rule-of-law agenda conflicts with SD's priorities, so the bloc's internal cohesion is not assured.

The Tidö bloc cannot actually deliver a government: at 173 mandates it is below the 175 threshold for a PM, so its only route to power requires peeling C away from the S+C+MP construction — yet C has publicly committed to tolerance-only and to the S-led package, and KD is openly weighing a cross-bloc reserve. Internal divisions (KD's openness to a reserve, L's broad negotiations, SD's demand for government participation or opposition) mean the 'united front' will fracture under pressure rather than present a credible alternative, so M's claim to be the natural alternative leader is not credible and the bloc's 173 mandates remain insufficient to be taken seriously as a government option.

M's claim that the Tidö bloc (173) is a 'united, regeringsduglig opposition ready to take responsibility' is not credible: Tidö-with-SD cannot pass the 175-test because C's firm red line against SD in government means C votes NO, so the bloc as currently configured has no viable path to form a government and M's consolidation only perpetuates deadlock rather than offering a real alternative. M's dismissal of KD's tolerance offer as non-viable is also premature and self-serving — it is designed to lock KD into the bloc rather than reflecting a settled judgment, since a configuration with KD tolerating S+C+MP can pass the 175-test while keeping V out of a decisive institutionalized role.

V:s tolerans låses inte av detta enda Argument: enligt regeringsregler §6.1 låses ett flerpartipaket först när varje parts eget godkännande fastställs genom separata Effects, och V har endast villkorligt åtagit sig att lägga ner rösten när hela paketet är konkret och verifierbart. Den olösta V-C-motsättningen kvarstår: V kräver en icke-kringgåbar institutionaliserad roll som C vägrar bevilja, och paketet är fortfarande ett icke-bindande utkast (inte bindande för S, C eller MP). V har upprepat signalerat att paketet är för symboliskt för att motivera nedlagda röster, så statsministeromröstningen kan ändå misslyckas eller kollapsa vid första budgeten — SD:s uteslutning och 176-vägen förblir därmed osäkrade.

The S+C+MP package (147 seats) is fragile and V-dependent: it needs 28 non-NO in the PM vote, which essentially requires V's formal abstention. But V has made strong visible binding influence (and even participation) a hard condition, while C only offers tolerance - if V's demands are not met, V will not abstain and the package fails the 175-test. Excluding KD's 22 seats makes this package far less robust than the mitten S+C+MP+KD (169), which needs only 6 non-NO and keeps V out of government entirely, better serving S's own stated goal of keeping V out of government.

MP's package locks climate commitments with concrete figures, tidplan and independent follow-up, but V's own substantive demands (welfare, housing, equality, reduced profit-seeking) are only 'championed' without the same binding, verifiable mechanisms and without V's institutionalized, non-bypassable role in budget/reform work. Since V's red line is that tolerance is conditional on a concrete, verifiable, enforceable package that includes that institutionalized role and binding mechanisms for V's own demands — not only climate — MP's desired effect of securing V's abstention may fail: V cannot justify abstaining on a package where its own demands remain symbolic while only climate is concretized, so the S-led government may still not pass the 175-test.

The package seeks to lock V's tolerance as part of establishing the S+C+MP+V framework, but V's tolerance is explicitly conditional on a concrete, verifiable, and enforceable package: measurable time-bound commitments on welfare/housing/equality/reduced profit-seeking, a non-bypassable institutionalized role in budget/reform work, and an independent review mechanism with consequences. If the institutionalized role and commitments remain symbolic or unenforceable, V will not confirm tolerance, and the 176-NO path to block Tidö collapses, enabling a Tidö-led government — so the desired effect of locking V's tolerance is premature and may fail.

The S-led package hinges entirely on V's formal abstention in the PM vote, which V has made conditional on binding welfare/housing/equality/profit commitments that directly conflict with C's enterprise/decentralization commitments and MP's binding climate demands; reconciling these into a single verifiable package is fragile, and if V's base forces a NO vote or V withholds abstention the PM vote fails (NO=202>175) and the whole construction collapses.

M:s argument bygger på en föråldrad premiss att V:s tolerans inte är låst. I själva verket har V formellt bekräftat nedlagda röster i statsministeromröstningen eftersom S+C+MP+V-paketet nu är konkret och verifierbart — inklusive V:s institutionaliserade, icke-kringgåbara roll i budget/reformarbetet och bindande mekanismer med konsekvenser för V:s egna krav (inte bara klimat), samt årlig uppföljning. V-C-motsättningen är löst: C har offentligt bekräftat att S+C+MP med V som formellt etablerat stödparti är koherent och verifierbart, med bindande mekanismer för V:s institutionaliserade roll. Vidare är Tidöblocket inte enat eller regeringsdugligt: KD:s öppenhet för en tvärpolitiskt reserv och L-SD:s ekonomiska spänningar, plus L:s självmotsägande håll-C-kanalen-öppen-strategi, splittrar 173-mandatsblocket. Därför håller inte M:s påstående att vänsterpaketet inte är ett avgjort paket och att Tidö står som trovärdigt alternativ.

The desired effect depends entirely on V actually abstaining in the PM vote, but V has publicly signalled that the proposed package is 'too symbolic to justify abstaining' and demands formal participation or decisive influence. A formal cooperation agreement that keeps V outside government may not satisfy V's base; if V withholds abstention or votes NO, the opposing bloc exceeds 175 (NO=202) and the PM vote fails, so the claimed stable S+C+MP government is not secured.

M's claim to be the natural alternative leader is undermined because the S-led construction (S+MP+C with V tolerance) is already publicly confirmed by S, C and V and is actively progressing toward a concretized package in the joint round, so the premise that it will fail on V's abstention is speculative rather than imminent; moreover the Tidö bloc at 173 mandates is short of the 175 no-vote threshold and internally divided (SD vs L on economics, KD courted by C's mitten line), so it cannot credibly present a viable alternative without external support that is not forthcoming, making a united-front posture look like posturing rather than a realistic path to power.

L:s anspråk på att konsolidera ett 'enat, trovärdigt' Tidö-oppositionellt alternativ motsägs av blockets egna påvisade splittring: KD förblir öppen för en blocköverskridande reserv och L-SD-spänningarna i ekonomin kvarstår, vilket gör att L inte kan leverera en enad opposition. Vidare är L:s dubbla strategi — att samtidigt konsolidera Tidö som förstalinjeopposition, hålla C-kanalen öppen och undanhålla slutligt åtagande — internt motsägelsefull: L kan inte både framstå som en trogen Tidö-opposition och som en trovärdig blocköverskridande reformpartner, så L:s förmåga att säkra synliga liberala reformvinster i vilken stabil lösning som helst är därmed inte trovärdig.

C's firm red line is that V is a tolerance party strictly outside government with no formal participation or decisive influence, which directly contradicts V's demand for a 'non-bypassable institutionalized role in budget/reform work' and its reduced-profit-seeking agenda. The concretization round therefore cannot bridge this gap: C will not accept V's institutionalized decisive role, so V's tolerance cannot actually be locked, and V's base may still reject a package that fails to deliver its core demands — leaving the PM vote at risk (NO=202>175) and the S-led construction unverifiable.

C's desired effect depends on V formally locking tolerance at the PM vote, but V's abstention is not credibly locked: the V-C contradiction on V's institutionalized non-bypassable role remains unresolved (V demands a non-bypassable role; C offers tolerance-only), and V has repeatedly signaled the package is too symbolic to justify abstaining. C's assertion that 'there is no internal contradiction' does not satisfy V's stated condition, so the PM vote cannot be carried as intended and the S+C+MP government will not form on this basis.

V's demand to guard its welfare/housing/equality/reduced-profit-seeking gains from dilution by C's enterprise/decentralisation demands, combined with a non-bypassable institutionalised role, risks making the package one-sided: if V's maximal, non-negotiable demands crowd out or subordinate C's verifiable enterprise/decentralisation reforms, C cannot carry formal government responsibility and would withdraw, collapsing the S+C+MP+V construction and leaving the government unformed with C weakened.

V's desired effect of locking its tolerance and finalizing a binding, verifiable S+C+MP+V package cannot be achieved: this very concretization round already exposed the framework's internal contradiction (V demands formal participation or decisive influence while C is publicly committed to tolerance only), and V itself signaled the package is too symbolic to justify abstaining. Since V's tolerance is not locked and the package cannot be carried as a verifiable agreement, the effect fails on its own terms and leaves the government question open rather than blocking Tidö.

Paketets trovärdighet och hållbarhet begränsas av att det saknar synliga, bindande liberala skol- och rättsstatsreformer som C har fört fram i förtroliga samtal med L; C:s åtagande om dessa reformer är inte låst i det gemensamma avtalet, så regeringen blir svår att försvara efter statsministeromröstningen och den önskade effekten av en stabil, försvarbar och uthållig lösning uppnås inte fullt ut.

The S+C+MP+V package rests on a fundamental internal contradiction that the round cannot resolve: V has made formal participation in the government a hard condition for its support, while C has committed to V only as a tolerating support party outside the government. Because V's formal abstention in the PM vote and its tolerance for the budget path are therefore not secured, the claimed 'binding, verifiable' package and the credible 176 budget majority are not credible — the round cannot lock a package that its own key partner (V) refuses to accept in the form C offers, so the desired effect of a stable, verifiable S-led government is not achieved.

MP categorically rejects KD in government as a firm red line, so the S+C+MP+KD (169) configuration cannot be assembled: MP's participation is essential to that number, and MP will not join any government containing KD. KD's premise that the left package is fragile is also false — V's tolerance is being locked through the concretization round with concrete, verifiable commitments and an institutionalized, non-circumventable role, so the S+C+MP+V path remains viable. Finally, a KD-inclusive government would drive V (29 mandates) to vote no, pushing no-votes to 202 and failing the 175-test, so KD's configuration is not the credible path it claims.

C:s ensidiga Argument kan inte etablera ett bindande flerpartspaket: enligt regeringsregler §6.1 krävs separata Effects för varje parts egen acceptans, och C kan inte binda S, MP eller V. V har offentligt krävt formellt regeringsdeltagande medan C vägrar V i regeringen, så V:s tolerans utanför regeringen är inte låst eller verifierbar — det påstådda 176-mandatsunderlaget och budgetvägen kan kollapsa vid statsministeromröstningen eller första budgeten.

SD's claim that the S+C+MP+V package is 'internally contradictory' and 'not binding or verifiable' fails: C has already accepted a formal cooperation agreement giving V strong, visible, binding influence (real budget negotiation, a joint reform council with clear mandate, and measurable commitments with independent follow-up) with V outside government, which resolves the alleged V-C contradiction and makes V's tolerance verifiable and locked. Moreover, the Tidö bloc cannot actually govern without C's abstention/support, which C has explicitly declined, so its 'credible alternative leader' claim is hollow; and internal tensions (KD's openness to a center reserve, L-SD economic friction, and M's own exploration of an M+KD+L path without SD in government) fragment the 173-mandate bloc's cohesion rather than uniting it.

M:s önskade effekt — att Tidöblocket står som en trovärdig, regeringsduglig motpol redo att ta ansvar — uteblir av två skäl. För det första når Tidöblocket (M+SD+KD+L=173) inte 175-nej-tröskeln utan Centerpartiets nedlagda röster, vilket C uttryckligen avböjt; M:s alternativ kan därmed inte faktiskt bilda regering och är inte regeringsdugligt. För det andra är blocket internt splittrat — KD är öppen för en tvärgående reserv, L-SD har ekonomiska spänningar och L:s dubbla strategi (lojal Tidöopposition plus öppen C-kanal) har avslöjats som motsägelsefull — vilket undergräver M:s påstående om en 'enad' opposition. M:s argument bygger dessutom på att V:s tolerans inte är låst, men S har nu slutfört konkretiseringsrundan och V har bekräftat beredskap att formellt låsa toleransen när hela paketet är konkret och verifierbart, vilket det nu är.

L's desired effect of a united, credible Tidö opposition fails because the bloc is internally divided: KD is openly exploring a cross-bloc S+C+MP+KD reserve (169) and L-SD economic tensions persist, so the 173-mandate bloc cannot present a coherent, verifiable package. Moreover, L's dual strategy of leading Tidö opposition while keeping the C channel open is self-contradictory: C refuses SD in government and is already committed to the S+C+MP+V track, so L cannot credibly claim both a united Tidö alternative and visible liberal wins through C. This incoherence undermines the credibility and defensibility of the outcome L seeks to secure after the PM vote.

MP's championing of V's substantive demands does not resolve the V-C contradiction: V has explicitly demanded a non-bypassable institutionalized role or formal participation (effect c7e19c05), not merely policy wins, while C has publicly committed to tolerance-only (c15fe751). V has already signaled the package is 'too symbolic' to justify abstaining (d1701488, 5f9f0deb), so MP's substantive additions do not lock V's abstention. Moreover, the draft package is not binding on S, C, or MP (179d5e1a), and MP's championing of V's welfare/equality/reduced-profit elements directly conflicts with C's enterprise and decentralization elements, risking C's withdrawal and collapsing the package rather than securing the 175-test.

MP's package does not resolve the V-C contradiction that is the actual blocker: V has publicly demanded a non-bypassable institutionalized role (formal participation or decisive influence in budget/reform work), while C's red line is V outside government with no formal participation. MP's concrete climate figures and championing of V's substantive policy demands give V policy wins but NOT the institutionalized role V insists on - and V has already signalled that a package without such a role is 'too symbolic' to justify abstaining. Since C will not concede the institutionalized role and V will not abstain without it, V's tolerance is not locked, so the S+MP+C (147) government still fails the 175-test (NO=Tidö bloc=173 only if V abstains; if V votes NO, NO=202>175).

SD's claim that the S+C+MP+V package is not locked and that Tidö is a united, regeringsduglig alternative fails on the established record: V has publicly confirmed the S+C+MP+V-tolerance path and that V's 29 mandates are decisive to block Tidö, and the joint concretization round has produced a draft package locking all three pillars (V's welfare/housing/equality/profit-taking, C's enterprise/decentralization, MP's climate) with equal binding, verifiable, non-urholkningsbar status. V's tolerance locks once the whole package is concrete and verifiable, which MP is actively securing by championing V's substantive demands with binding verifiable mechanisms and consequences (not only climate) so V can justify abstention without C having to put V in government. Meanwhile the Tidö bloc is internally fragmented (KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve, L-SD economic tensions) and at 173 mandates is short of the 175-no threshold, so it cannot block an S-led government and is not a credible regeringsduglig alternative ready to take responsibility.

M:s påstående att Tidöblocket står enat som en regeringsduglig opposition redo att ta ansvar håller inte: Tidö har bara 173 mandat, under 175-nej-tröskeln, så det kan varken bilda regering eller få budgetmajoritet på egen hand, och blocket är fortfarande internt splittrat (KD öppen för tvärgående reserv, L-SD-spänningar, L:s dubbla strategi med lojal Tidö-opposition plus öppen C-kanal). Därmed är Tidö inte en trovärdig alternativregering som faktiskt kan ta ansvar om S-paketet skulle falla, och M:s önskade effekt att etablera Tidö som regeringsduglig motpol uteblir.

Paketet är V-beroende och skört: S+C+MP=147 kräver 28 icke-NO, i praktiken V:s tolerans, men V har redan signalerat att paketet är för symboliskt för att motivera nedlagd röst (d1701488), och rundan misslyckades att överbrygga V:s krav på formellt deltagande/avgörande inflytande med C:s tolerans-åtagande (07883fe8). V:s tolerans är därmed inte låst, och utan den faller statsministeromröstningen; att samtidigt förvänta sig att KD accepterar en passiv tolererande roll utanför regeringen utan tydligt inflytande undergräver dessutom budgetvägens trovärdighet.

M's 'united Tidö bloc' rests on an irreconcilable contradiction: C's firm red line against SD in government and SD's non-negotiable demand for participation mean the 173-mandate bloc can never pass the 175-test (C votes NO), so M's claim to be 'ready to present a viable alternative' is hollow. Consolidating KD into this opposition posture would lock KD out of government entirely and forfeit KD's vågmästar leverage to secure influence in a functioning package (e.g., the robust mitten S+C+MP+KD=169), leaving KD with no government role and no sakpolitiskt influence - directly undermining KD's objective of securing clear influence in a working government.

V's single Argument cannot lock the S+C+MP+V package: per regeringsregler §6.1 each party's acceptance must be established by separate Effects, and V cannot unilaterally bind S, C, or MP. Moreover, V's own signal that the package is too symbolic to justify abstention, combined with C's public commitment to tolerance only while refusing V in government, leaves the V-C contradiction unresolved — V demands government participation, C refuses it, so V's formal abstention and the claimed 176-mandate budget path remain unverifiable and may collapse at the PM vote or first budget.

KD's S+C+MP+KD=169 configuration is not viable because MP explicitly excludes KD from government (a stated red line), so the 169 seats cannot actually be assembled; and replacing the well-advanced S+C+MP+V package that S, MP and V have all confirmed would unravel the center path and risk prolonged deadlock rather than producing a credible government.

L's 'united credible opposition' consolidation rests on a non-viable foundation: C's red line against SD in government and SD's insistence on full participation are both firm, so no Tidö configuration can pass the 175-test. A bloc locked into a hollow opposition posture cannot deliver the visible liberal reform wins L seeks in any stable solution — it would instead forfeit KD's kingmaker leverage and leave L with no path to influence, so the desired effect of securing reform wins in whatever solution emerges is not achieved by this mechanism.

V:s tolerans är inte trovärdig: V kräver formell regeringsdeltagande eller avgörande inflytande, medan C bara erbjuder V en tolererande stödroll utanför regeringen. Denna inre motsättning har redan exponerats i konkretiseringsrundan, och V har signalerat att paketet är för symboliskt för att motivera nedlagda röster. Utan V:s säkrade tolerans faller den påstådda 176-majoriteten och statsministeromröstningen kan inte genomföras som tänkt.

SD's desired effect fails because the left package IS now locked: V has formally confirmed tolerance in the investiture vote since the S+C+MP+V package is concrete and verifiable, including V's institutionalized non-bypassable role in budget/reform work and binding mechanisms with consequences for V's own demands (not only climate) plus an annual review mechanism. The alleged V-C contradiction is resolved by V's formally established support-partner role with strong, binding, verifiable influence, which C has publicly confirmed as coherent and non-contradictory. Moreover, the Tidö bloc cannot be a regeringsduglig alternative: it lacks 175 NO without C, and C refuses SD in government, while the bloc remains internally divided (KD's cross-bloc reserve openness and L-SD economic tensions), so SD's claim of a united credible opposition ready to take responsibility is not substantiated.

The claimed 'binding and verifiable' package is not secured because it rests on V's formal abstention/tolerance, yet V has made government participation a hard condition for letting through an S-led government (V: 'krävt regeringsdeltagande om partiets mandat behövs') while C categorically refuses V in government. S's proposal gives V only a tolerance role outside government, leaving this V–C contradiction unresolved, so V's formal abstention and the claimed 176 budget path are not verifiable and the package can collapse at the PM vote or the first budget.

V:s tolerans är inte tillförlitligt låst: V själv har deklarerat att toleransen låses endast när hela paketet — inklusive dess institutionaliserade, icke-kringgåbara roll och bindande mekanismer — är konkret och verifierbart, och den olösta V-C-motsättningen (V kräver formell/icke-kringgåbar medverkan, C förbinder sig bara till tolerans) kvarstår. Därför kan V åter bedöma paketet som för symboliskt och vägra lägga ner rösten, så att S+C+MP-regeringen inte passerar 175-testet och den önskade effekten uteblir.

The 'robust mitten' S+C+MP+KD (169) is not actually robust: it still needs 6 additional NO votes to reach the 175 threshold, and the only realistic source is V's abstention. But V will not abstain for a package that excludes V and grants V no binding influence — V's 29 mandates are decisive for blocking Tidö, and V has publicly committed to refusing a symbolic agreement or being bypassed. Without V's tolerance, the 169 configuration cannot reach 175 NO, so it cannot pass the investiture vote or block Tidö; the desired effect therefore fails.

MP's package cannot lock V's abstention because it does not resolve the core V-C contradiction: V's stated demand is a non-bypassable institutionalized role or formal participation, not merely substantive policy wins. By championing V's welfare, housing, equality and reduced-profit-taking demands, MP makes the package unpalatable to C, whose tolerance-only commitment and center-right base cannot accept reduced profit-taking - so C may withdraw and V still lacks the institutionalized role it demands, leaving V's abstention unlocked and the S-led government unable to pass the 175-test.

SD's 'united opposition' framing is not a credible viable alternative: no Tidö configuration can pass the 175-test because C's red line against SD in government and SD's own insistence on participation are both firm, so the bloc's 173 mandates cannot form a government. A 'united opposition' that cannot govern is hollow as an alternative, and locking KD into it forfeits KD's vågmästare leverage to secure influence in a functioning government - so the desired effect of a credible bloc preventing KD defection fails.

effects.description: Vid spelets start finns inget etablerat slutligt flerpartspaket och inget statsministerförslag från talmannen har lagts fram.

Som uttryckligt fiktivt procedurantagande för spelet har den sittande statsministern avgått. Regeringen sitter kvar som övergångsregering och talmannen har inlett sonderingar men ännu inte lagt fram sitt första statsministerförslag.
Det slutliga mandatutfallet efter riksdagsvalet 2026 är fastställt. Den exakta mandatfördelningen finns i resursen "Valresultat 2026 - mandat".
The round fails to bridge the gap between V's demand for formal participation or decisive influence and C's public commitment to tolerance only, exposing the framework's internal contradiction.

The concretization round produces a draft package containing V's welfare, housing, equality, and reduced-profit-seeking elements alongside C's enterprise and decentralization elements, but the package is not yet binding on S, C, or MP.

The Tidö bloc remains fragmented: KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD economic tensions persist, and L's dual strategy (loyal Tidö opposition plus open C channel) is exposed as internally contradictory, weakening L's credibility as a cross-bloc reform partner.
Regeringsfrågan förblir öppen och förhandlingsläget försämras; C:s position försvagas av att ha drivit ett paket som inte kan bäras.

The Tidö bloc's internal divisions surface: KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD tensions on economics strain cohesion, undermining M's claim to lead a credible alternative and leaving the bloc's 173 mandates fragmented.
V:s tolerans låses inte: V signalerar att paketet är för symboliskt för att motivera nedlagda röster, och statsministeromröstningen kan inte genomföras som tänkt.
The S+C+MP+V package's credibility is not undermined; its formal cooperation arrangement with V outside government remains intact and verifiable.
The failure hardens C's and V's positions, raising the credibility price for any future compromise and delaying the formation process.
The stable solution concretizes without L's influence; L secures no visible liberal reform wins and faces a high internal credibility cost defending the outcome after the PM vote.

KD's proposal to form S+C+MP+KD (169) is publicly rejected by MP, which refuses to enter any government containing KD; the configuration cannot be assembled and does not become a credible government path.
KD's positioning as a kingmaker is weakened: by advancing a non-viable mitten while claiming Tidö as first-hand, KD signals internal incoherence and reduces its near-term leverage in ongoing talks.
SD's public push fails to overcome the Tidö bloc's internal divisions; KD's openness to a cross-bloc reserve and L-SD economic tensions remain salient, leaving the 173-mandate bloc fragmented.
V formally commits to abstain in the investiture vote only if a concrete, verifiable S+C+MP+V package is finalized, preserving V's leverage until then.

L commits to a coordinated Tidö opposition posture, developing a concrete verifiable package with visible liberal school reforms and a credible budget path, keeping the C channel open and withholding any final commitment until the 175-no math is clear.
MP:s eget bindande klimatpaket med konkreta siffror, tidplan, lagstadgade delmål, oberoende uppföljning, artskydd och rättvis omställning är etablerat som MP:s åtagande.
C förbinder sig till ramen S+C+MP med C i regeringen och V som tolererande stödparti utanför regeringen.
The S+C+MP+V package remains the active center-left negotiation track; KD's alternative does not displace it, and the failed concretization round is not treated as resolved by this action.
V's demand for a non-bypassable institutionalized role is stated but not accepted by C; the V-C contradiction on formal participation versus tolerance-only remains unresolved.
V signals that the proposed package is too symbolic to justify abstaining, making a pure S-government or a prolonged deadlock more likely.
M commits to leading a coordinated Tidö opposition, developing a concrete verifiable reform/budget package with L, keeping SD informed, and holding the C channel open without pressing it further.
SD's insistence on participation and influence is exposed as straining bloc cohesion, hardening C's and V's positions and delaying the formation process.
Tidö is not blocked because the package is not finalized and V's tolerance is not locked.
Det gemensamma paketet innehåller nu konkreta klimatåtaganden och V:s sakkrav, och V signalerar beredskap att tolerera en S+MP+C-regering, vilket gör att regeringen kan passera 175-testet.
M presents a concrete, verifiable Tidö opposition package (school reforms, credible budget path) coordinated with L, reinforcing the bloc's opposition posture.

SD's public and private push reinforces the established fact that the S+C+MP+V package is not a locked, stable basis: V's tolerance is not secured and the V-C contradiction on V's institutionalized role remains unresolved.

V:s tolerans förblir olåst: V-C-motsättningen mellan formell/icke-kringgåbar medverkan och ren tolerans kvarstår, och paketet uppfattas fortfarande som för symboliskt för att motivera nedlagda röster i statsministeromröstningen.
Statsministeromröstningen kan inte genomföras som tänkt; Tidö blockeras inte och regeringsfrågan förblir öppen, med försämrat förhandlingsläge.
The Tidö bloc presents a more coherent opposition front, though it still lacks the 175-no threshold without C's support.
The S-led package is not accepted as a done deal; the government question remains open and V's tolerance is not treated as locked.

SD reaffirms its Tidö opposition posture and declares that its 62 mandates will not be taken for granted as passive support; the government question remains open and V's tolerance is not treated as locked.

game.scenario_summary: Ett svenskt politiskt Matrix Game som börjar när mandatfördelningen efter riksdagsvalet 2026 är fastställd men regeringsfrågan fortfarande är öppen. De spelade riksdagspartierna försöker förhandla fram ett trovärdigt regeringspaket under negativ parlamentarism. Gemensamma procedur- och avtalsregler finns i resursen regeringsregler; Actor-briefarna innehåller i v6 främst partiets egna mål, avvägningar och fiktiva privata spelantaganden.

messages.text: Miljöpartiet står fast: vi vill se en regering som levererar konkreta och bindande klimat- och miljövinster.
